exam_scheme.note: The IISER Aptitude Test (IAT) is conducted annually by the Joint Admissions Committee across the Indian Institutes of Science Education and Research (IISERs) for admission to the 5-year BS-MS dual degree and 4-year BS degree programmes across 7 autonomous IISER campuses: Berhampur, Bhopal, Kolkata, Mohali, Pune, Thiruvananthapuram, and Tirupati. IAT scores are also used for admission to the Bachelor of Science (Research) programme at IISc Bangalore and the BS in Medical Sciences & Engineering at IIT Madras. The exam is a Computer Based Test (CBT) of 180 minutes duration consisting of 60 multiple-choice questions carrying a total of 240 marks. The paper comprises four mandatory sections with 15 questions each: Biology (15 questions, 60 marks), Chemistry (15 questions, 60 marks), Mathematics (15 questions, 60 marks), and Physics (15 questions, 60 marks). Marking scheme: +4 marks for each correct response, -1 mark for each incorrect response, and 0 marks for unattempted questions.
